description: Trigger scheduler tasks from outside cognia, and sign / customize outbound webhook deliveries.

events.auditHelp: Durable record of every inbound command dispatch and outbound delivery (survives restart).
events.description: Built-in event types you can subscribe to with an event-triggered task. The ‘Emit test’ buttons fire a synthetic payload through the same path an inbound POST /events would take.
events.heading: Scheduler event types

types.agentTeamCompleted: An agent team run reached a terminal status.
types.backupNeeded: Backup interval elapsed and a new backup is due.
types.connectionOutboundSend: An outbound message was sent through a connector.
types.connectionScheduledDigest: A scheduled connection digest was published.
types.custom: Free-form event — typically posted from external tooling.
types.goalCompleted: A goal loop reached a terminal status.
types.planCompleted: A plan reached a terminal status.
types.sessionCreated: A new chat session was created.

inbound.allowlistHelp: Default 127.0.0.1/32. Add LAN ranges (e.g. 10.0.0.0/24) only if you really need off-loopback access.
inbound.capabilityHelp: Read tokens may only hit the health route; write tokens may run triggers. Applied on the next listener start.
inbound.capabilityRestartNote: Changing capability takes effect after you toggle the listener off and on.
inbound.commandPermissionsHelp: Least-privilege access control — turn off any target you don't want remote callers to run. A disabled target is rejected with 403 target_disabled even for a write token. Applied on the next listener start.
inbound.commandTargetsHelp: Authenticated POSTs to these routes dispatch into the matching subsystem.
inbound.desktopOnlyNotice: Inbound triggers run on the desktop runtime only. Open cognia as a desktop app to enable a local listener.
inbound.enabledHelp: Starts a local 127.0.0.1 HTTP server bound to the chosen port.
inbound.enabledRequiresToken: Generate a bearer token before enabling the listener.
inbound.hardeningHelp: Always-on protections beyond the bearer token and IP allowlist.
inbound.nonLoopbackWarning: Non-loopback entry detected — anything on this network can hit the listener if they have the bearer token.
inbound.quickstartHelp: Copy-paste client snippets. Export your bearer token as COGNIA_RC_TOKEN first.
inbound.rateLimitHelp: Requests above the limit get HTTP 429. Default 60.
inbound.sensitiveHelp: Some targets cause model-cost or off-device side effects. They are rejected with 403 even for a write token unless you explicitly allow them.
inbound.tokenHidden: Token hidden — click reveal to view.

outbound.defaultHeadersHelp: Sent with every outbound webhook delivery. Content-Type is always application/json and cannot be overridden.
outbound.deliveryHelp: Applied to every outbound webhook delivery — per-task URLs and egress endpoints alike.
outbound.deliveryMaxRetriesHelp: Retry attempts after the first send (0–10).
outbound.description: Optional HMAC-SHA256 signature added to every outbound webhook delivery. Receivers can verify the request actually came from this cognia install.
outbound.endpointHeadersHelp: Merged onto every delivery to this endpoint, on top of the global default headers.
outbound.endpointsHelp: Standalone webhook endpoints any subsystem (scheduler, goals, workflows, team, plans) can publish lifecycle events to. Each delivery is signed with the secret above.
outbound.heading: Outbound webhook signing
outbound.perTaskHint: Per-task webhook URLs are configured on each scheduled task in the Scheduler page.
outbound.retryConfigSummary: Retries: {retries}, base delay {baseDelayMs} ms, request timeout {timeoutMs} ms.
outbound.signingSecretHelp: Stored in the OS keyring on desktop. Deliveries then carry the Standard Webhooks header trio (webhook-id / webhook-timestamp / webhook-signature).
outbound.subscriptionSummary: {count, plural, =0 {All events} one {# event type} other {# event types}}
outbound.subscriptionsHelp: Deliver only the selected event types to this endpoint. Select none to receive every event.

overview.statusDesktopOnly: Inbound listener is desktop-only. Outbound + Events still work in the web build.

title: Remote Control
